artworks.title: Stéphane Mallarmé, No. 2
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a seated person, focusing on the upper body. The figure is wearing a V-neck garment and has short, dark hair. The head is turned slightly to the left. The background is plain with no additional details. The sketch features loose strokes indicating arm placement and is signed "Whistler" on the right side.

artworks.title: The Shoemaker
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting two individuals. One person is seated, visible from the knees up in a side profile position with a neutral expression. They have abundant hair framing their face, wear a long-sleeved garment, and have objects on a table nearby. The other person stands behind, partially visible in profile, with hair styled away from their face and wearing a dress with long sleeves. They lean on a chair back, appearing to observe the seated individual or the surroundings. The background suggests an interior setting with faint outlines of walls and furniture.

artworks.title: The Medici Collar
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a full view sketch of a person standing upright, depicted from the head to slightly below the knees. The person has a slightly downward-facing gaze, softly sketched facial features, and short or pulled back hair. They wear clothing with large, pronounced shoulders, a high collar, and loose flowing structure. The background has minimal details.

artworks.title: Draped Figure, Standing
artworks.medium: lithograph in orange on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a standing person. The person is in a leaning position with their head tilted slightly downward and one hand on their hip while the other arm falls by their side. The facial features are soft and slightly abstract, with wavy hair flowing down to the shoulders. They are wearing a long, flowing garment that drapes around their body and reaches the ground, depicted with sweeping lines. No visible jewelry or objects are present, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Draped Figure, Reclining
artworks.medium: color lithograph on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person reclining on a sofa. They are depicted from head to lower legs, with their body leaning back against the cushions and legs extended outward. The person's facial features are lightly sketched, with a calm expression and a small, rounded face. Their hair is dark and covered by a yellow hat or cap. They are dressed in a long, flowing yellow garment and holding a scroll or fabric with green details. There are cushions around them, one with green spots. The background features light pastel shades with green and orange, suggesting a wall decoration. Small decorative elements are present in the composition. The artwork has a light and delicate quality.

artworks.title: The Girl
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper

artworks.title: Nude Model on an Empire Sofa
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person sitting upright on a surface with their entire body visible. The individual is seated with their legs extended diagonally and hands placed behind them for support. Their facial features are sketched with soft lines, showing a frontal view, and their hair is short and slightly tousled. There are no visible clothing items on the person. Around the individual, there appears to be a faintly sketched fabric to the right side on the surface they are sitting. The background is plain with faint line work suggesting walls or surrounding surfaces.

artworks.title: Draped Model, Standing
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch features a person leaning slightly against a surface or ledge in a relaxed standing position. The individual has one arm resting on the surface and the other bent at the elbow. The person's facial features are softly drawn, with the head slightly tilted downward. The person's hair is short and their outfit is a loose garment that flows around their body, possibly a robe or cloak. The background is minimal, with no distinct elements or details present other than the signature marking on the right side of the sketch.

artworks.title: Mrs or Miss McNay
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on folded wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person's upper body in a reclined position. The individual's face is in a side profile with closed eyes and a relaxed expression. The hair is loosely drawn to show texture and volume. The clothing is sketchily indicated with lines resembling textured fabric. The artwork has minimal details and a plain background of the same color as the paper, with no other objects present.

artworks.title: Standing Female Nude Holding a Bowl [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite, colored chalk and pastel on brown paper
artworks.description: The image displays a full-body sketch of a person standing upright in a side-view position. The person is holding a large, oval object, possibly a platter or basin, with both hands at waist level. The background is a uniformly textured brown paper.

artworks.title: Study for "Variations in Blue and Green" [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on brown paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract figures on brown paper. The drawing is composed of rough, gestural lines that suggest the outline of abstract human-like forms. The sketch features curved and overlapping lines creating an impressionistic display, with no distinct, detailed features. The drawing appears to have been created using a dark pencil or charcoal on a brown textured paper.

artworks.title: Nude Standing with Legs Crossed
artworks.medium: chalk on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a nude figure standing with one hand on the hip and the other touching the head. The person's facial features are softly rendered, suggesting closed eyes, and the hair is styled up. There is no clothing on the figure, emphasizing the natural form. The background is plain and textured in a brown shade. The composition is simple and focused, with the figure standing out against the backdrop.

artworks.title: Nude Leaning on a Rail [recto]
artworks.medium: chalk and pastel on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a forward-bent position, resting their elbows and forearms on a horizontal surface, facing away from the viewer. The person's head is turned slightly to the left, and they have short hair with a possible yellow band or ribbon. The person is unclothed, without jewelry. The focus is on the contours and posture of the body. The background is a plain brownish surface with sketch lines and faint shading.

artworks.title: Standing Figure [verso]
artworks.medium: chalk on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a faint sketch of a full-body outline of a standing person on brown paper. The person's arms are close to the body with indistinct details, and the facial features and hair are not clearly defined. There is no clothing, jewelry, or objects visible, and the background is solely the brown paper.

artworks.title: Seated Woman with Red Hair
artworks.medium: pastel and chalk on brown paper
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a seated person on the edge of a bench or chair. The person is leaning forward with their head lowered, wearing a flowing garment. They have long hair tied back, and hold an object in their right hand. The background is plain and textured, with no clear features.

artworks.title: Sheet of Sketches [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures and a medallion. The artwork consists of three distinct sketches on a single sheet. At the top, there is a linear sketch of a draped figure holding a wheel-like object. In the middle, a sketch depicts an animal-like figure with a wheel by its side. At the bottom, there is a circular design resembling a medallion featuring the face of a lion with a prominent mane, bordered by ornate detailing. The lion medallion is supported by a cylindrical pedestal.

artworks.title: Studies for Jewelry Designs [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite and pen and brown ink on folded laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of sketchy figures and forms on a plain background. The drawing consists of various small and loosely sketched figures and symbols distributed across the page. At the top and middle, there are sketches of intertwined abstract forms. Below them is a figure that appears to be a small, cherubic form sitting on a circular shape. To the right, a smaller, similarly styled figure is sketched. Near the bottom, two small square designs with obscure details are drawn. The overall style is freeform and exploratory, with a focus on abstract and imaginative elements.

artworks.title: Studies for Jewelry Designs [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on an envelope of laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays abstract pencil sketches featuring circular shapes intersected by curving lines and scribbles. Some figures resemble musicians or figures seated on spherical bases. The arrangement of lines and curves adds a sense of flow and movement, with some figures overlapping with a tangled mass of pencil strokes.

artworks.title: Harper Pennington
artworks.medium: chalk and pastel on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a relaxed pose. He is wearing a light-colored suit jacket, dark trousers, white shirt, red tie, and brown hat. He has a mustache and one arm is bent inward while the other is extended outward. The background is neutral and textured.

artworks.title: Woman with a Fan
artworks.medium: black crayon heightened with white (chalk?) on brown paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person in a three-quarter view facing left. The individual has their arms crossed or holding something close to the chest. The head is turned away, with hair gathered in a bun. The person wears a long dress with drapery and folds. No visible jewelry or objects are shown, and the background is textured brown paper.

artworks.title: Two Sketches of Landscape Pictures hung at the Society of British Artists
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rough pencil drawing on a paper with two landscape sketches on it. In one sketch, the horizon is high in the frame showing hills or low mountains and cloud-like shapes. The other sketch has a simpler horizon with jagged peaks, possibly representing mountains or trees, against a more expansive area. The pencil work is light and sketchy, with minimal lines. The color palette is monochromatic, in graphite-gray on tan paper.

artworks.title: Sketch of Mrs. Godwin's Portrait when hung at the Society of British Artists
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a room with a curtained area and faint outlines of furniture. The drawing is a delicate sketch composed mostly of light pencil strokes on a plain background. The lines suggest the presence of a curtained window or opening on the right side, and what appears to be a framed picture hanging on a wall. The drawing has a minimalist approach, with very few details accentuated, giving it a sense of openness and airiness. The inclusion of drapery adds a soft element to the overall structure.

artworks.title: Miss Cumberlege
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person depicted in sketch form. The person is seated in a relaxed position, with most of the upper body visible. Their facial features are outlined, with a gentle expression and short, cropped hair. They are wearing a long garment, likely a dress or robe, with dynamic sketch lines suggesting folds and texture. The surrounding environment is represented with sketchy lines, hinting at furniture or domestic objects in the background but without clear definition. There is a small, round object on a flat surface to the person's left. The sketched background consists of vertical and horizontal lines, evoking a sense of an interior setting but remaining abstract.

artworks.title: Arrangement in Black - No.3
artworks.medium: graphite, pen and brown ink on off-white laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a woman shown from head to toe, standing in a confident pose. The woman's head is slightly turned to the left, facing forward. She has delicately drawn facial features, short hair framing her face, and is wearing a long black gown with a deep neckline. A light-colored wrap or scarf drapes around her arms and shoulders. She is holding a part of her outfit. There is no visible jewelry. The background has sketchy cross-hatching and lines, creating a textured effect. The sketch is labeled "Arrangement in Black, No 3" beneath the figure.
